description: MEDIUM PRIORITY: Database performance and reliability improvements. Add missing indexes to heavily queried columns, improve Redis error handling for graceful degradation, add audit logging for sensitive operations, implement 2FA preparation (schema stubs), and document security best practices. This feature addresses performance bottlenecks and operational security.
steps: 1. DATABASE INDEXES - backend/prisma/schema.prisma: Add compound index to Product model: @@index([active, categoryId, rating]) for filtered category browsing sorted by rating. Line ~110 area.
2. DATABASE INDEXES - schema.prisma: Add compound index to Product: @@index([active, sellerId]) for seller product listings. Already has @@index([sellerId]) at line 95 - make it compound.
3. DATABASE INDEXES - schema.prisma: Add compound index to Order: @@index([userId, status]) for user order history filtered by status. Line ~225 area.
4. DATABASE INDEXES - schema.prisma: Add compound index to Order: @@index([status, createdAt]) for admin order dashboard sorted by date. Line ~225 area.
5. DATABASE INDEXES - schema.prisma: Add index to OrderItem: @@index([sellerId, createdAt]) for seller order tracking. Line ~245 area. (sellerId already indexed at line 244 - make compound).
6. DATABASE INDEXES - schema.prisma: Add compound index to Review: @@index([productId, createdAt, approved]) for product reviews page with moderation filter. Line ~290 area.

7. DATABASE INDEXES - schema.prisma: Add compound index to CartItem: @@index([userId, productId]) for cart lookups. Already has @@unique([cartId, productId, variantId]) at line 145 - add separate userId-based index for cross-cart queries if needed.
8. DATABASE INDEXES - Run migration after schema changes: `npx prisma migrate dev --name add-performance-indexes`
9. REDIS GRACEFUL DEGRADATION - Find all Redis/cache usage. Check backend/src/middleware/cache.middleware.ts and any redis client initialization.

10. REDIS GRACEFUL DEGRADATION - Wrap all Redis operations in try-catch. On error, log warning and continue without cache. Example: `try { await redis.get(key); } catch (err) { logger.warn('Redis unavailable, continuing without cache', err); return null; }`

11. REDIS GRACEFUL DEGRADATION - backend/src/config/redis.ts or wherever Redis client is initialized: Add error event handler: `redis.on('error', (err) => logger.error('Redis error', err));` Don't throw, just log.
12. REDIS GRACEFUL DEGRADATION - In auth.service.ts account lockout logic (from FEAT-003): If Redis unavailable, fall back to in-memory Map with periodic cleanup.
13. AUDIT LOGGING - backend/src/repositories/audit-log.repository.ts: Create if doesn't exist. Add methods: logUserAction(userId, action, entityType, entityId, details, ipAddress, userAgent).
14. AUDIT LOGGING - Use AuditLog Prisma model (already in schema.prisma line 290) to record: USER_LOGIN, USER_LOGOUT, PASSWORD_CHANGED, PASSWORD_RESET, ORDER_CREATED, PAYMENT_CONFIRMED, ADMIN_ACTION.

15. AUDIT LOGGING - backend/src/services/auth.service.ts: After successful login (line ~105), call auditLogRepository.logUserAction(user.id, 'USER_LOGIN', 'USER', user.id, null, req.ip, req.headers['user-agent']).
16. AUDIT LOGGING - Apply audit logging to: logout, password change, password reset, order creation, admin order status changes, seller profile updates.
17. TWO-FACTOR AUTH PREP - backend/prisma/schema.prisma: Add to User model: `twoFactorEnabled Boolean @default(false)`, `twoFactorSecret String?`. Line ~40 area.
18. TWO-FACTOR AUTH PREP - Run migration: `npx prisma migrate dev --name add-2fa-fields`
19. TWO-FACTOR AUTH PREP - Document in SECURITY.md: 2FA fields are present but not yet implemented. Preparation for Phase 2 enhancement.

20. SECURITY DOCUMENTATION - Update backend/SECURITY.md (created in FEAT-001) with sections: Rate Limiting Strategy, XSS Prevention, CSRF Protection, Token Management, Account Lockout Policy, Audit Logging, Password Requirements, File Upload Security, Database Security (parameterized queries), Error Handling, Secrets Management.
21. SECURITY DOCUMENTATION - Add security.txt file at backend/public/.well-known/security.txt (create public/ dir if needed) following RFC 9116 format: Contact, Expires, Preferred-Languages.

22. PRODUCTION CHECKLIST - Create backend/PRODUCTION_CHECKLIST.md: Environment variables verification, secrets rotation, database backups configured, Redis configured, rate limits appropriate for production traffic, CORS origin set correctly, DETAILED_ERRORS=false, NODE_ENV=production, HTTPS enabled, monitoring/alerting configured.
23. API DOCUMENTATION - Update any existing API docs (if docs/ folder exists) with security requirements: authentication, rate limits, CSRF token requirements, file upload limits.

24. INPUT VALIDATION - Audit all Zod validators in backend/src/validators/*.validator.ts: Ensure email domains validated (email schema), password strength requirements documented, numeric inputs have min/max bounds, string inputs have length limits.
25. FINALIZATION - Run full backend test suite: `npm test` in backend/. Fix any broken tests due to security changes (e.g., token blacklist affecting test cleanup).
acceptance_criteria: 6+ new database indexes added to Prisma schema for products, orders, reviews, cart queries
Prisma migration successfully applied with new indexes
Redis errors handled gracefully - application continues without cache if Redis unavailable
Audit logging implemented for user authentication, password operations, orders, and admin actions
User model has twoFactorEnabled and twoFactorSecret fields (not yet implemented, preparation only)
SECURITY.md comprehensively documents all security measures implemented
PRODUCTION_CHECKLIST.md exists with deployment security requirements
All Zod validators have appropriate constraints (length limits, numeric bounds, email validation)
Database queries are measurably faster on large datasets due to indexes
verification: Run `npx prisma migrate dev --name add-performance-indexes` after schema changes - migration succeeds
Run `npx prisma generate` to regenerate Prisma Client with new schema
Run `npm run lint` in backend/ - no TypeScript errors
Run `npm test` in backend/ - all tests pass
Manual verification: Check backend/prisma/migrations/ for new migration folder with index additions
Manual verification: Start backend with Redis disabled (stop Redis service), hit authenticated endpoints, verify they work (slower but functional) and logs show Redis warnings not errors
Database query test: Connect to PostgreSQL, run EXPLAIN ANALYZE on product search query, verify indexes are used
Manual verification: Perform login, check audit_logs table has USER_LOGIN entry with correct userId, action, timestamp, ipAddress
Manual verification: Read SECURITY.md, security.txt, and PRODUCTION_CHECKLIST.md - all sections complete and accurate
Grep check: `grep -r "twoFactorEnabled" backend/prisma/schema.prisma` returns User model field
Performance test: Query products with categoryId filter and rating sort, compare execution time before/after indexes (should be faster with indexes)
